html:
Croatia is a country on the eastern shore of the Adriatic. The map shows it as a medieval kingdom from 1000 to 1200 and as an independent republic in 1994 and 2010.

Croats settled the region in the 600s. Their dukes became Christian, and around 925 Tomislav became the first king of the Croatian kingdom. In 1102 the crown passed to the king of Hungary, and Croatia stayed in a union with Hungary for eight centuries, keeping its own nobles' assembly and governor. After 1527 that meant rule by the Habsburgs. On the coast, Venice held Dalmatia, and Dubrovnik was the free Republic of Ragusa.

In 1918 Croatia joined the new state that became Yugoslavia. It declared independence in 1991 and fought the Croatian War of Independence until 1995. It joined the European Union in 2013.
